summary: Verified RERA modal bug fix end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 pytest tests pass (GET returns RERA fields at top level, PATCH persists ProjectStatus/TotalUnits/PossessionDate/LandArea/NeedsReview at top level and NOT dumped into Fields.*, non-RERA rows untouched). Frontend Playwright: (1) RERA section hidden in Add Property modal - PASS, (2) hidden for non-RERA card PROP-0009 - PASS, (3) default view shows 9 non-RERA cards, RERA chip toggles to show 5 RERA cards - PASS, (4) RERA card modal shows all 11 fields correctly populated (RERANumber, RERARegistrationDate, ProjectStatus, Configurations, TotalUnits, AreaRange as 'min – max', PossessionDate, LandArea, ImportedFrom, ImportedAt, NeedsReview) - PASS, (5) editable fields (status=Completed, units=777, possession=2029-06-30, land=2222.5, needs-review toggled) persisted after save+reopen - PASS. All acceptance criteria satisfied.

openEditModal fetches via /api/v2/inventory/:id but relies on res.data.Photos; ensure list endpoint & detail endpoint field parity is guaranteed by tests.
seed_data_creation: None needed; 5 RERA + 9 non-RERA rows already present.
